comment: Copy _template.json to <id>.json and _template/ to <id>/. Set a unique id, entrypoint, code path and settings. Implement ClientAddition using the public engine API; no Minecraft.java edits or hard-coded ID checks are needed. Run gradlew buildAdditions, or supply a prebuilt JAR. api is the executable API version (currently 1). Files beginning with _ are ignored. Switches and settings remain in additions.txt.
